_help: Act 2, the labour market: hiring Khalil Darwish's local labourers (hired_khalil), 250 up front, or 130 now and 120 owed (owe_khalil). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

fatima.speaker: fatima
fatima.line: I am Fatima el-Sayed. I place workers with employers. Khalil Darwish's men are dockworkers without docks. Strong, and cheap.

already.speaker: khalil
already.line: My men are fed and ready.

first.speaker: khalil
first.line: Khalil Darwish. My men lift anything, dig anything. Two hundred and fifty pounds.

choices.label: Hire the crew
choices.line: Two hundred and fifty, up front.

choices.label: Half now, half later
choices.line: Half now, the rest when we're back.

joined.speaker: khalil
joined.line: Paid before a stone is lifted. Good.

joined_owed.speaker: khalil
joined_owed.line: Half. Very well. They will be waiting for the other half.
